uplink.description: Status report: 3.6 V, sensor ON, 300 mm (0.3 m) to surface, 50% full
uplink._note: TTN example input (netvox r718pe codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3.6, Status 'ON', Distance 300, FillLevel 50. Distance 300 mm -> tank.distance 0.3 m; FillLevel 50 -> tank.level 50%.

uplink.description: Status report, low battery + higher fill: 3.6 V (low), 1500 mm (1.5 m), 20% full
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds input. byte3 = 0x80 | 36 -> battery 3.6 V + lowBattery. Distance bytes[5..6] = 0x05DC = 1500 mm -> 1.5 m. FillLevel 20.

uplink.description: Device-info / startup version frame (report type 0x00) carries no measurement
uplink._note: TTN example startup version report (byte2 == 0x00). Upstream returns Device/SWver/HWver/Datecode; we carry no measurement here and report an error.

uplink.description: Configuration response on fPort 7 carries no measurement
uplink._note: TTN example ConfigReportRsp on fPort 7. Config frames carry no measurement; reported as an unsupported fPort error.
